name: wasm-wasi-overview
description: Minimal Node.js examples that walk through the four WebAssembly import/export kinds (function, global, memory, table).

scripts.build: wat2wasm function/function.wat -o function/function.wasm && wat2wasm global/global.wat -o global/global.wasm && wat2wasm memory/memory.wat -o memory/memory.wasm && wat2wasm table/table.wat -o table/table.wasm
scripts.examples: npm run example:function && npm run example:global && npm run example:memory && npm run example:table
